reason: The existing mapping does not provide a defensible basis for maintaining an inventory of models, components, data sources, and subcontractors. Article 13 focuses on transparency and instructions for use, while Article 25(4) addresses contractual obligations for third-party suppliers, neither of which directly mandates or supports the creation and maintenance of such an inventory.

missing_mappings.reason: Article 16(1) requires providers to establish and maintain a quality management system, which includes the documentation of the design, development, and post-market monitoring processes. This provision directly supports the need for an inventory of components and subcontractors as part of a comprehensive quality management system.

applicability_note: This control is applicable to third-party components, as the AI Act imposes specific obligations on providers of high-risk AI systems to manage their supply chain and ensure compliance with the regulation.
challenge_comment: The control requires a formal inventory, which is a foundational element of a quality management system. While Article 25(4) addresses contractual relationships with suppliers, it does not mandate the creation of an inventory. The existing mapping lacks a provision that directly supports this specific documentation requirement.
